method_notes: Each repository was cloned with depth 1 at the tip of its default branch and scanned before any later unshallow. The tree at clone_head is what was scanned.
Plain scans used vault-guard scan on the clone, with --format json and --fail-on none. blocking_matches is 0 because fail-on is none; by_severity is the detection count.
Findings keep rule, file, line, offset, severity, source and both fingerprints. The matched value is not stored.
No code from either clone was executed.
Wall time is noisy: the load average on this 8-core machine was high while OmniRoute was scanned, and its three runs spread from about 69s to about 105s.
